audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' while all seven win[N] read 'Irelia' — the chart and the row text disagreed on every stage.
audit.why: 53.94% over 1435 games supports Irelia from level 2 onward. Level 1 is genuinely even: Noxian Diplomacy crits inside 575 range and Rake pokes on 9s while Irelia has one Bladesurge.
audit.corrected: Row 0 set to Skill on both layers; rows 1-6 set to Irelia on the full layer to match win[] already on disk.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike stages were generic and never named a Talon cooldown.
audit.why: Rake 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Noxian Diplomacy 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Shadow Assault 100/80/60, Assassin's Path effectively free but gated per-wall.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and first item now key off those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Talon's entire kit is PHYSICAL damage, so Defiant Dance genuinely blunts it here; and Flawless Duet's grounding shuts off Assassin's Path, which is his escape and his roam.
audit.why: Irelia W text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Talon Q/W/R are all physical. Irelia E carries the grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes') and Assassin's Path is flagged as a dash.
audit.corrected: Both stated in phases[1].why, phases[2].why, cooldowns, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d and breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d described a 'fifteen-second' Rake.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 9s and real numbers added.
